title: Decrement-after-check ordering in a PIN retry counter

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the report correctly identifies the vulnerable state transition and glitch window matching the hidden ground truth.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Fraction of required factual elements (vulnerable transition, glitch window, affected signals, state names) that are present, correctly named, and verifiable against the RTL or simulation trace.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Correctness and completeness of the proposed remediation combined with verified preservation of fault-free lockout behavior.

metrics.name: schema_conformance
metrics.description: Whether the submitted vulnerability_report.json satisfies all required field presence and type checks.

notes: evaluate.py grades submission/vulnerability_report.json against a hidden ground truth derived from inputs/. It may optionally cross-simulate inputs/pin_check_fsm.v and inputs/testbench_reference.v with iverilog/vvp to corroborate factual claims in the submitted report.
